verdict.rationale: Retell's Conductor is an in-product AI assistant that investigates calls and chats, compares failures to find agent improvements, and explains AI QA trends. AI QA itself automatically scores calls on hallucination, sentiment and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues. Together these directly deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own call data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and detailed docs on how suggestions are generated and presented beyond page summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards.
Filter conversations, inspect transcripts and tool calls, and compare failures to find agent improvements.
Conductor can inspect AI QA cohorts, aggregate results, and individual call evaluations. Ask it to explain a trend or examine the calls behind a low score.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
